QuestInfo.name: A Little Game
QuestInfo.0: There's no particular reason you have to get yourself involved in all of this, but something deep down in your heart is nagging you to make the right choice instead of the rational, self-serving choice.
QuestInfo.1: You don't even know what's going on anymore, or what you should do. Perhaps it's best to leave your destiny to fate, letting the will of heaven guide your path.
QuestInfo.2: You decided to work with the real Handsome Monk to save the town. Perhaps in your heart, you'd already decided that even before you said as much.
